posts.author: SirGamers
posts.body:
Hey y'all,
Making my first RPG Maker game here. Trying to find a plugin of some sort that can let me
bold
,
underline
,
italicize
, etc etc, you get the idea.
Does anybody know any?
(also, if anyone has suggestions for any other plugin that's good for beginners or you personally use or anything in general, those would be appreciated)

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body: The engine happens to have unused (?) code for bold and italic text, so those will probably be easier to find plugins for than underline. E.g. VisuStella Message Core: http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Message_Core_VisuStella_MZ#Global_Hard-Coded_Text_Codes Makes subsequent text bold. Removes bold from subsequent text. Makes subsequent text italic. Removes italic from subsequent text. Alternatively, in case VisuStella's plugin adds stuff that you don't want, I have a plugin called Cae_CustomTextCodes that simply lets you define your own text codes: Spoiler: suggested setup With my plugin, you can open its parameters in the Plugin Manager and from there define a new Process Text Code like this to toggle boldface: Label: B Arguments: [Integer] Delimiters: [] Separator: , Replacer: this.contents.fontBold = !!parseInt(args[1]); Then use it in Show Text like: The last word in this sentence is \b[1]bold\b[0]. If that works (I haven't tested), then you could define another one for italics by copy+pasting the bold one you just made, changing the Label to something else (e.g. I ), and swapping fontBold for fontItalic in the Replacer field. This would only work in places where the engine allows text codes, e.g. the Show Text window. SirGamers said: also, if anyone has suggestions for any other plugin that's good for beginners Click to expand... My recommendation would be to learn the engine first, and get familiar with the sort of thing that is already available without plugins. Then if you find yourself stuck trying to do something, consider looking for a suitable plugin.
